title: Thermal cycling + mobility rehearsal
summary: Find arid, low-vegetation terrain with high diurnal ΔT and traversable slopes for rover thermal and wheel/surface checkout under Earth gravity — then document what does not transfer to Moon/Mars.
earthLimitsAlways: Earth gravity ≠ Moon (1/6 g) or Mars (~0.38 g)
Earth atmosphere and radiation environment do not transfer
Biosphere and contamination constraints are Earth-unique
